description: This file contains function definitions for VLAN management using Open vSwitch commands, including creating/deleting bridges, adding/removing interfaces, and VLAN configuration management. It is part of the VLAN abstraction layer for RDK-Broadband.

methods.name: vlan_hal_addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new OVS bridge with specified group name and VLAN ID.

methods.name: vlan_hal_delGroup
methods.description: Deletes an existing OVS bridge with specified group name.

methods.name: vlan_hal_addInterface
methods.description: Adds an interface to an existing OVS group.

methods.name: vlan_hal_delInterface
methods.description: Removes an interface from an OVS group.

methods.name: vlan_hal_printGroup
methods.description: Prints the configuration of a specific OVS group.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves interface names matching certain criteria.

methods.name: vlan_hal_delete_all_Interfaces
methods.description: Deletes all interfaces associated with a given group.

methods.name: insert_VLAN_ConfigEntry
methods.description: Stores VLAN configuration (group name and VLAN ID) into internal linked list.

methods.name: delete_VLAN_ConfigEntry
methods.description: Removes VLAN configuration for a given group name from internal linked list.

methods.name: get_vlanId_for_GroupName
methods.description: Retrieves VLAN ID associated with a given group name.

methods.name: print_all_vlanId_Configuration
methods.description: Prints all VLAN configurations stored in internal linked list.
